verdict.rationale: Hightouch's own docs say Customer Studio builds traits and audiences on top of resolved identities in the warehouse. That is a first-party but thin mention of computed traits that sit alongside audience building. Nothing in the pack documents predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity); AI Decisioning recommends message, channel and timing, which is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: any evidence of predictive LTV/churn/propensity scoring, detailed docs on defining computed traits, explicit use of traits as targeting filters, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, computed traits and predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are calculated on profiles and usable in targeting

citations.quote: Identity Resolution unifies a person's identifiers into one resolved identity, and Customer Studio builds traits and audiences on top.
